title: Learning to Assimilate: Amortized Control for Autoregressive Diffusion
abstract: arXiv:2510.06637v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Autoregressive diffusion models (ARDMs) offer expressive priors for forecasting chaotic dynamics. However, maintaining consistency with sparse observations over long rollouts can require substantial test-time computation. We introduce Control-Augmented Data Assimilation (CADA), which trains a lightweight controller on top of a frozen ARDM to steer predictions toward future observations. Using a KL-regularized stochastic optimal control objective, the controller learns from short autoregressive rollouts to anticipate observations while staying close to the pretrained dynamics. At inference, it injects corrections at each denoising step without per-forecast optimization. Across two chaotic PDE benchmarks, CADA improves long-horizon accuracy, stability, and physical fidelity under sparse observations. translated_title: 学习同化：自回归扩散的摊销式控制
translated_abstract: 自回归扩散模型（ARDMs）为混沌动力学的预测提供了富有表现力的先验。然而，在长程滚动预测过程中保持与稀疏观测的一致性可能需要大量的测试时计算。我们提出了控制增强数据同化（Control-Augmented Data Assimilation, CADA），该方法在一个冻结的 ARDM 之上训练一个轻量级控制器，将预测引导向未来的观测值。通过使用 KL 正则化的随机最优控制目标，控制器从较短的自回归滚动中学习，在预测观测的同时保持贴近预训练的动力学。在推理阶段，它在每个去噪步骤注入校正，无需针对每次预测进行单独优化。在两个混沌 PDE 基准测试上，CADA 在稀疏观测条件下提升了长程预测的精度、稳定性和物理保真度。在紧凑的 ERA5 数据集上，它在大多数情形下优于基于扩散的基线方法，且推理速度比条件扩散模型快 10 倍以上。
tldr: 提出了 CADA 方法，在冻结的自回归扩散模型之上训练轻量级控制器实现摊销式数据同化，无需逐次预测进行优化即可提升稀疏观测下的长程预测精度，并将推理速度提高 10 倍以上。
en_tdlr: Proposes CADA, which trains a lightweight controller on a frozen autoregressive diffusion model for amortized data assimilation, improving long-horizon forecasting accuracy under sparse observations without per-forecast optimization while achieving over 10× faster inference.
